addon.name: Merge Playlist into one File
addon.summary: Joins every track of a playlist into a single M4A file, keeping each track's start and stop times.
addon.description: Concatenates the tracks of a playlist into one M4A audio file, honouring the per-track start-time/stop-time set through #EXTVLCOPT. Open a playlist, then View > Merge Playlist into one File. Roughly one minute of work per hour of audio.
